title: The Disc in the Chains
description: Three throws, one orange disc, and the sound Shane loves best.
subtitle: Shane has one goal in the woods: make the basket ring.

cover.alt: Alex teaching Shane the surfer stance on the disc golf tee pad in Whispering Woods.

blocks.html: Shane held his orange Roadrunner disc at the first tee. Far down the path stood a basket with silver chains. “I want to hear them ring,” he told Dad.
“Then let’s give it a try,” said Dad. He took his pink disc from the bag. Shane looked down the fairway. One big tree stood between him and the basket.

blocks.alt: Alex showing Shane the sideways surfer stance on the tee pad in Whispering Woods, with Shane holding his bright orange disc.
blocks.caption: Shane picks a path past the big tree.

blocks.html: He pointed past the trunk. “Around the tree. Toward the chains.” Dad grinned. “That’s the plan.”

🗣️ Say it with Shane

Around the tree. Toward the chains.
Shane stepped sideways and threw. The disc sailed past the big tree, then dropped into the pine needles. A squirrel on a branch gave a little chatter.
“It made it past the tree,” said Dad. Shane ran to his disc and tried again. This time it glided right toward the basket. For one breath, Shane thought it might go in. But it landed just short.

blocks.alt: The bright orange disc golf disc soaring in a looping arc through the sunny woods past a curious squirrel on a branch as Shane and Alex cheer.
blocks.caption: The Roadrunner glides through the woods.

blocks.html: “So close,” he said. Dad nodded. “Now you’ve got an easy shot.” Shane picked up the Roadrunner and walked closer. He could see every link in the chains.

🗣️ Say it with Shane

One more throw.
Shane held the disc with both hands. He took a breath, chose a spot in the middle of the chains, and tossed.
Ching! The disc dropped into the basket. Shane froze. Then he jumped so high Dad had to catch him.

blocks.alt: The orange disc golf disc lands in the metal chains with golden sparkles while Alex scoops Shane up in a big celebratory bear hug surrounded by woodland friends.
blocks.caption: Shane hears the chains ring at last.

blocks.html: “You heard it!” Dad said. “I made it ring!” Shane said. The squirrel chattered again, as if it had been waiting for that sound too.
Dad tapped his pink disc against Shane’s orange one. They walked to the next tee together. Shane carried the Roadrunner under his arm, already looking for the next basket.

🗣️ Say it with Shane

Ching!
